article.title: Jacob Rees-Mogg issues style guide to staff
article.excerpt: 1. Organizations are SINGULAR 2. All non-titled males — Esq. 3. There is no . after Miss or Ms 4. M.P.s — There is no need to write M.P. after their name in body of text 5. Male M.P.s (non-privy councillors) — in the address they should have Esq. before M.P. (e.g., Tobias Ellwood, Esq., M.P.) 6. Double space after fullstops 7. No comma after ‘and’ 8. CHECK y
